title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2023: a look back
excerpt: The best players showed their skills
body_html:
Let’s remember once more how Super Cup ATTP – SUMMER 2023 went on 12-13 August.

These were the most expressive, memorable and some of the finest table tennis competitions in the Republic of Moldova in recent years.

Thank you to all the participants and spectators who were with us that day. Thank you to all the sponsors who helped make the event happen at the highest level.

Special thanks to our main partners — SETKA-PRO Moldova and TOP CUP Academy — for the prize fund, the constant improvement of table tennis playing conditions and their contribution to developing the sport in Moldova.

And we take this opportunity to note that just over a month remains until the ATTP Super Cup – AUTUMN 2023, which closes the autumn table tennis sessions, and every participant can be a winner or a prize-winner.
